question_en: How are HARQ-related sections distributed across the TSs? (scope of HARQ implementation)
original_query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*HARQ.*' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(sec) AS sectionCount, collect(sec.sectionNumber) AS sections ORDER BY sectionCount DESC
reference_query:
MATCH (population:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(owner:Spec)
WITH DISTINCT owner.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: specNumber})
WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*HARQ.*'
RETURN specNumber, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY specNumber
